extracted.intended_audience: journalism students and student photojournalists (and instructors using SNO curriculum)
extracted.subtask_description: A classroom-facing lesson on ethical principles for photojournalists, introducing what ethics are, why to follow them, the NPPA Code of Ethics, and activities to apply those principles to scenarios and to build a personal/organizational ethics code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and responsibility of photojournalists
rubrics_metrics.description: By reporting visually on events, photojournalists not only have the power to surpass language barriers, but also to reveal truths, to expose wrongdoing, and to connect individuals around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use photography to inform and reveal truth while recognizing that this power carries responsibility; decisions should weigh the public-interest value of a photograph against potential harms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid intrusiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Photographs can also cause harm if they are intrusive...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be mindful of invasion of privacy and intrusive behavior when photographing subjects, especially in vulnerable situations; avoid actions that unduly disturb or exploit subjects for the sake of an image.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid manipulation and dishonesty
rubrics_metrics.description: Photographs can also cause harm if they are... manipulated, or dishonest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not digitally alter images or stage scenes in ways that change the factual content or mislead viewers; maintain accuracy and authenticity in capture and post-processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to the NPPA Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: What is the National Press Photographers Association? NPPA Code of Ethics breakdown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the NPPA Code of Ethics as a primary professional standard; the lesson provides links to view/print the NPPA Code for student use and a slide presentation explaining its provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply specific ethical principles to real scenarios
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the NPPA Code of Ethics, students will read through five ethical scenarios and determine how they would act under the described circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating scenarios, reference specific NPPA principles in answers to demonstrate familiarity and reasoning; the activity trains decision-making grounded in the Code rather than ad hoc judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a comprehensive, updated photojournalism ethics code
rubrics_metrics.description: As today’s photojournalism landscape continues to evolve, the temptation for dishonest shooting and digital manipulation has become much higher, raising many new ethical standards for photojournalists to consider.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate a broad set (the activity references 'over 20 ethical standards') and compile a tailored ethics code reflecting current technological and professional challenges; this is an exercise in selecting and justifying standards appropriate to one’s newsroom or practice.
